title: Regenerate pack and re-run full PDF/source audit + new gates, then re-freeze
description:
Thaw scope #8. FORMAL regeneration and re-freeze — the LAST step of the
program. Regenerate the rules-pack from the importer, re-run the legacy
PDF/source audit (old criteria) PLUS the new playable-model gates and runtime
smoke tests, refresh docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/ evidence and manifests,
and re-freeze the importer/extractor/parser/pack/oracle with updated freeze and
thaw notes.

SEQUENCING (rewritten 2026-07-25; the historic eshyra-o9bd.16 -> eshyra-o9bd.14
and eshyra-o9bd.15 -> eshyra-o9bd.14 edges were removed and reversed). Re-freeze
may begin ONLY after all of the following have completed:

  1. Reference-engine certification under eshyra-olc5 — gates 19.6.1 below.
  2. eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1  full corpus recompilation and reclassification.
  3. eshyra-o9bd.19.6.2  permanent regression evidence for every finding.
  4. eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3  candidate audit bundle passes the automated no-repeat
     gates.
  5. eshyra-o9bd.16      independent max-effort audit of that CANDIDATE bundle.
  6. eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4  acceptance of those findings and zero-repeat
     certification.

The pack audited in step 5 is a candidate. This bead is what makes it frozen.

RE-FREEZE BAR:
  * All 10 legacy re-freeze-bar items green.
  * The revised NINE-POINT green definition (see notes) satisfied for every
    deterministic clause that feeds engine execution.
  * ZERO engine-pending deterministic clauses. A clause does not count as green
    because the pack appears to contain enough data; the reference
    implementation must demonstrate that it does.
  * Non-executable clauses permitted only in the four approved categories:
    campaign-ruling ambiguity, intentional model adjudication, external non-SRD
    content, and explicitly deferred non-deterministic house rules — each
    represented in-band and failing closed.
notes:
Gated on the 2026-07-01 audit epic eshyra-o9bd.18: hard dependencies wired to its concrete pack-changing defect beads (18.1-18.5, 18.6.1-18.6.3, 18.8.1, 18.8.2). bd forbids epic->task blocking, so the epic itself could not be wired; per the epic policy, remaining o9bd.18 children (gameplay modeling epics, gates, cleanup) must each be closed or carry an explicit documented non-issue/defer decision before re-freeze.
2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: The re-freeze evidence must distinguish the compiler-owned pack closure from external engine readiness. Green compiler closure requires deterministic regeneration, source/reference completeness, semantic projections or source-grounded curated specs where needed, and explicit hook/disposition bindings for runtime ownership. Do not count an unlanded engine dependency as green merely because the pack names it; it must stay represented as engine-pending or be backed by engine-side evidence under the appropriate owner.
*** SEQUENCING CORRECTED (2026-07-25) ***
Re-freeze now happens LAST. This bead depends on eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4
(certification of zero-repeat closure), which depends on eshyra-o9bd.16
(independent max-effort re-audit of the candidate bundle). The historic
eshyra-o9bd.16 -> eshyra-o9bd.14 edge was removed and reversed.

Do not regenerate or re-freeze until certification exists. eshyra-2zyy (restore
SRD thaw-note CI gating) now depends on this bead.
*** GREEN DEFINITION REVISED (2026-07-25) — SUPERSEDES the 8-point version ***
DECISION: where structured pack data is a DIRECT INPUT to deterministic
execution, the pack contract and the reference engine are ONE co-designed
system. The pack defines what the engine must execute; the reference engine
proves the representation is sufficient and unambiguous. Freezing the pack
first would preserve a separation that does not exist in practice.

A deterministic clause that feeds engine execution is GREEN only when all nine
hold:
  1. Complete source-clause identification.
  2. Clause-complete structured representation.
  3. Complete field provenance.
  4. Explicit capability requirements.
  5. A provider-neutral engine implementation exists.
  6. Reference-engine conformance tests exercise the PACK representation.
  7. Correct tool exposure and state mutation.
  8. Fail-closed behavior for unsupported input.
  9. Successful replay / deterministic equivalence where applicable.

A clause is NOT green merely because the pack appears to contain enough data;
the reference implementation must demonstrate that it actually does. A
representation reference that merely RESOLVES to an existing object is not
green — the Opus amended magic-item pass proved reference integrity but
explicitly did NOT prove semantic appropriateness of free-form effects.

AT RE-FREEZE THERE MUST BE ZERO ENGINE-PENDING DETERMINISTIC CLAUSES. The only
permissible non-green clauses are four approved categories:
  * genuine source ambiguity routed to campaign rulings;
  * intentionally model-adjudicated material;
  * external content unavailable in the SRD;
  * explicitly deferred non-deterministic house-rule behavior.
Each must be explicitly represented in-band, carry its alternatives and
campaign-ruling requirement, and fail CLOSED.

WHY (audit evidence): the 2026-07-24 findings were structures that looked
plausible in isolation but failed as executable inputs — alternative damage
modes stored as parallel damage, recharge triggers read as reset periods,
partial saves treated as complete, legendary actions with no budget or cost,
option mechanics hoisted onto parent features, typed records missing
branching/timing/termination. A completed reference implementation forces these
to surface: a dragon-breath scenario cannot pass without half-damage handling;
a legendary-creature scenario cannot pass without a budget; a versatile attack
cannot execute without a discriminated alternative.

CONSEQUENCE FOR SEQUENCING: eshyra-olc5 is no longer a downstream project that
may stay open after eshyra-o9bd closes. Its reference-implementation
certification gates eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1 and therefore the formal re-freeze in
eshyra-o9bd.14.
*** RE-FREEZE BAR REPLACED (2026-07-31) — ADR 0020 NINE-CONDITION MODEL ***
Authority: ADR 0020 ("Prior assumptions" item 4) and section 5.9 of the
integrated transition design
docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md
— the accepted deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed head
afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). Recorded here as accepted authority
and required next state; NOT implemented in code by this bead update.

The recorded bar in the description above — "ZERO engine-pending deterministic
clauses" — is WITHDRAWN. It requires a global negative the corpus cannot support
(RulesRecord.data is typed unknown; kind validators accept unregistered data
fields; key closure over mechanics exists for magic-item only). Re-freeze now
requires all NINE of the following, none of which is a global closure claim:

1. Source fidelity — every retained record's content is traceable to the licensed
   source, with the known source-authority defects repaired or explicitly
   re-sourced.
2. Truthful provenance — provenance.sourceRef and locator correspond to real
   source material; a record whose locator cannot be substantiated is not frozen
   as authoritative.
3. Deterministic reproducibility — npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exits 0 against
   the pinned source.
4. Truthful scope for every audit and readiness artifact — every artifact in
   sections 5.1-5.6 states its scope in band and claims nothing outside it.
5. Durable disposition of known findings — every finding in the registry carries
   an explicit disposition under ADR 0020 section 7, including retirements that
   name their replacing responsibility.
6. Correctness of positively selected capabilities — each capability in force
   declares operation, inputs, exclusions, revision/identity, and residual
   interpretation, and each fails closed on unrecognized input.
7. No known source invention — no compiler-authored content carries source
   provenance or the source licence block.
8. No unowned live runtime safety contract — every runtime gate that can block a
   mutation has a live owner and a regression test.
9. Explicit unresolved discovery and adjudication limits — the re-freeze evidence
   states what discovery and adjudication do NOT guarantee.

EXPLICITLY NOT REQUIRED: global deterministic closure; universal discovery
completeness; zero engine-pending clauses; a corpus-wide negative claim of any
kind.

EVIDENCE PROVIDERS for the new conditions (dependencies wired on this bead):
• condition 1 and 7 — eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1 (source-authority repair, incl. the
  decided removal of table:starting-wealth-by-class from the SRD pack).
• condition 4 — eshyra-o9bd.19.14 (transition W14, artifact dispositions for
  sections 5.1-5.6).
• condition 5 — eshyra-o9bd.19.1.15 (durable finding registry); bulk finding
  disposition is sequenced after it exists and is not performed by this bead.
• condition 6 — eshyra-olc5.6 (transition W13, capability-contract
  normalization), which itself depends on eshyra-uiax.
• conditions 3 and 8 remain with the existing verifier and runtime-gate owners.

The freeze manifest and thaw-note POLICY are retained unchanged (transition
design section 5.8): a change to audited pack bytes stays a reviewed event. What
changed is the bar this bead waits on, not the mechanism. eshyra-2zyy still
depends on this bead.
